# Test fixtures

All files in this folder are **original, generated by `scripts/generate-fixtures.mjs`** and dedicated to the
public domain (CC0 1.0). They are intentionally tiny so they can run in CI.

| File                   | Purpose                                                                       |
| ---------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `cube.glb`             | Single box mesh with one PBR material                                         |
| `multimesh.glb`        | Hierarchy with nested group, rotation and non-uniform scale (3 meshes)        |
| `multi-material.glb`   | One mesh with two materials (two glTF primitives)                             |
| `textured.glb`         | Hand-written GLB with an embedded 8×8 PNG base-color texture                  |
| `car-loose-wheels.glb` | Single mesh: body, cabin and four **disconnected** wheels (typical AI output) |
| `car-fused-wheels.glb` | Same car with each wheel **connected** to the body by a bridging triangle     |
| `malformed.glb`        | Valid GLB header with corrupted JSON chunk                                    |
| `unsupported.xyz`      | Not a 3D file                                                                 |

Regenerate with `npm run fixtures`.
